description: This file defines the TasksController class in an ASP.NET Core Web API project. It handles HTTP requests related to task management, including retrieving all tasks, fetching tasks by ID, creating, updating, and deleting tasks. The controller uses dependency injection for the task service and introduces multiple API endpoints with appropriate routing and response handling.

classes.name: TasksController
classes.description: API controller for managing task-related operations including CRUD functionality.

methods.name: GetAll
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve all tasks; returns a list of TaskDto objects.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve a specific task by its ID; returns a TaskDto or NotFound.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to create a new task; returns the created TaskDto with a 201 status.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Handles HTTP PUT requests to update an existing task; returns the updated TaskDto or NotFound.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Handles HTTP DELETE requests to delete a task by ID; returns NoContent or NotFound.
